name: Pili torti-developmental delay-neurological abnormalities syndrome
aliases: Pili torti with neurological abnormalities syndrome
Pili torti with developmental delay syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of pili torti hair shaft abnormalities confirmed by microscopic examination
Global developmental delay manifesting in early childhood
Neurological abnormalities including hypotonia, seizures, or ataxia
Additional hair shaft abnormalities such as fragility or sparse scalp hair
Exclusion of metabolic disorders by normal metabolic screening

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pili torti confirmed microscopically plus global developmental delay and at least one neurological abnormality
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by hair shaft microscopy; genetic testing may aid but is not definitive.

laboratory: Hair shaft microscopy showing pili torti
imaging: Brain MRI may show nonspecific white matter abnormalities or cerebellar atrophy
genetic: No single gene identified; possible autosomal recessive inheritance pattern
other: Electroencephalogram (EEG) abnormalities consistent with seizure activity

distinguishingFeatures: Pili torti but without significant neurological delay
Pili torti with sensorineural hearing loss
Absence of developmental delay or neurological abnormalities
Characteristic kinky hair different from pili torti

redFlags: Early onset global developmental delay with hair shaft abnormalities
references: Orphanet: Pili torti-developmental delay-neurological abnormalities syndrome - ORPHA:2891
